strict_schema.interpreter: portable fail-closed subset in Python/TS/Dart/Kotlin/Swift; strict RFC 8259 + RFC 7493 parser: leading UTF-8 BOM, invalid UTF-8, nesting deeper than 32 open containers (pre-recursion bound, same maxDepth as api/catalog.v1.json), duplicate keys compared as exact code point sequences (never normalized; Swift uses scalar-keyed JKey), unpaired surrogate escapes, NaN/Infinity and double overflow are malformed

container_integrity.layout: Header first; Schema/Channel/Message only; one DataEnd with nonzero CRC-32 of preceding bytes; Footer without summary; MCAP0 magic
container_integrity.official_reader: mcap 1.6.0 StreamReader(validate_crcs=True): every accepted golden ok; data_crc_header_corrupt/data_crc_payload_corrupt raise CRCValidationError; data_crc_zero treated as unavailable by the official reader but rejected by this contract
container_integrity.chunked_production_files: rejected by portable readers (E_UNSUPPORTED_LAYOUT); verify.py --mcap uses the official reader with validate_crcs=True
container_integrity.definitions: streamed in file order by all five readers: Channel nonzero schema_id and Message channel_id must already be defined (E_DEFINITION_ORDER); a Schema/Channel id redefined with non-identical record bytes or a Schema with reserved id 0 is E_DEFINITION_CONFLICT; byte-identical repeats accepted (identical_duplicate_definitions, facts equal valid)
container_integrity.official_reader_definitions: mcap 1.6.0 make_reader(validate_crcs=True): channel_after_messages and schema_after_channel raise McapError (no channel/schema record found); bogus_channel_redefined_after_messages reads all 17 FrameEvents on /bogus/topic; identical_duplicate_definitions reads the same topic counts as valid (asserted in verify.py)
container_integrity.strings: record and message strings are strict UTF-8 in every reader and keep a leading U+FEFF (video_frame_id_bom); previously Dart stripped a BOM and Kotlin/Swift substituted U+FFFD

sa50_final_review_corrections.F1: definition order and conflicting redefinitions enforced while streaming in all five readers; 7 new goldens
sa50_final_review_corrections.F2: leading BOM rejected before decoding in every parser; Dart BOM-preserving decode for record/message strings; json_bom, video_frame_id_bom goldens and bom_prefix direct case
sa50_final_review_corrections.F3: MAX_DEPTH 32 enforced before recursion in all five parsers; depth 32/33 direct cases (root arrays, deep unknown value/objects, 20000 levels, brackets inside strings) and json_nesting_at_limit/json_nesting_over_limit goldens
sa50_final_review_corrections.F4: unpaired surrogate escapes malformed everywhere; Swift keys compared by exact scalars; composed/decomposed, U+FFFD, astral pair and escaped duplicate direct cases plus json_lone_surrogate golden
